about: A marquee moves a strip of items across or down in a loop. Its pause control stops it until the reader plays it again, and under pauseOnInteraction a pointer over it or focus inside it pauses it while it is there. A screen reader reads the items once, and the copies that fill the loop are hidden from it and from Tab. Under reduced motion the items rest and the pause control is hidden.

controlled.about: The application keeps the pause in its own state. It passes it as paused and takes each change from onPauseChange, so the switch and the marquee report the same state.
controlled.label: Exchange rates
controlled.title: Controlled pause

finite.about: The strip waits a second, runs twice and stops. onLoopComplete counts the loops and onComplete reports the end.
finite.label: Service notices

notices.contact: Questions go to the support desk.

finite.title: Finite loops

gap.about: Gap sets the space between two items, and the same space across the join of two copies.
gap.title: Gaps

rtl.about: Under dir="rtl" the items read from the right and the strip moves towards the right, the start of the line. The pause control sits at the left, the end of the line.
rtl.title: Right to left

speed.about: Speed sets how many pixels the strip moves each second: 25, 50 and 100.
